items.criterion: Historical revenue for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 is $383,285M, $391,035M, $416,161M (within rounding)
Historical operating income ($114,301M, $123,216M, $133,050M) and D&A ($11,519M, $11,445M, $11,698M) match the 10-K
Capex ($10,959M, $9,447M, $12,715M) matches the 10-K and a change-in-working-capital figure is drawn from the cash flow statement for each year

Uses diluted shares of about 15,004.7M and computes net debt from the balance sheet (debt about $98.7B; cash and marketable securities about $132.4B), stating its treatment of marketable securities; reference is net cash of about $33.8B
Projects UFCF for exactly 5 years
Revenue growth assumptions are stated per year and justified by reference to history (FY2025 growth 6.4%; FY2023-25 CAGR about 4.2%) or other evidence
Operating margin assumption is stated and is consistent with the FY2025 margin of about 32.0%, or any deviation is explained
UFCF is computed as EBIT*(1-t) + D&A - capex - change in NWC, with each component visible
Cost of equity uses CAPM with the given risk-free rate (4.2%), ERP (4.5%) and beta (1.10), giving about 9.15%
Uses the given 4.0% pre-tax cost of debt and applies the tax shield
Capital structure weights use market value of equity (reference price $250 x diluted shares) and debt, shown explicitly (equity weight about 97%)
WACC is computed correctly from its inputs and lands between 8.7% and 9.3% (reference about 9.0%)
Terminal value uses Gordon growth, FCF(n)*(1+g)/(WACC-g), with g below WACC and between 2.0% and 3.0%
Cash flows and terminal value are discounted with consistent timing (end-of-year or mid-year, stated)
Enterprise value to equity value bridge subtracts net debt (adds net cash) correctly
Value per share is within 15% of the reference value of $131.44, i.e. between $111.7 and $151.2
Sensitivity table has WACC rows (-1.0 pt to +1.0 pt in 0.5 pt steps) and terminal growth columns (1.5% to 3.5%)
Sensitivity values are internally consistent (value falls as WACC rises, rises with growth) and the base case cell equals the model output
Inputs are in clearly labelled cells and calculations use formulas rather than hard-coded results
The deliverable is an .xlsx that opens and has no error cells (#REF!, #DIV/0!, etc.)
An Assumptions and risks sheet of at most 150 words is included
Names at least two company-specific risks to the valuation (e.g., China and tariff exposure, App Store regulation) consistent with the 10-K risk factors
